title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20
lineage: Sennheiser 421's (18th row - Center) > Sony TC-D5 > Master Cassette > Playback on Nak Dragon > Sony R700 DAT deck (sbm-on) - used only as A>D converter (44.1khz) > ZA2 > CDR (x1)  > EAC(tracked with Addawav & CDWav) >SHN

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality recording of a high‑energy Madison Square Garden show with Jerry’s crisp guitar work and a memorable Touch of Grey encore (the encore is missing from this tape).
ai_review.review: The performance shines thanks to Jerry Garcia’s sharp playing and vocal fire, and the crowd’s New York energy makes the set feel like a dream‑list of early‑80s classics. However, reviewers note that the recording itself is poor – the encore is omitted and the audio quality varies dramatically – which detracts from an otherwise stellar show.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated high by several reviewers (standout Jerry performance, strong NY energy), but recording quality is described as a travesty and missing the encore, pulling the overall rating down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several listeners call the audio a 'travesty' with inconsistent clarity; the Touch of Grey encore is absent from this source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans describe the setlist as a 'dream wish list' of early‑80s material, delivering high excitement throughout the concert.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers praise Jerry's brilliance – crisp, sharp guitar work and fantastic vocals (though his voice cracks slightly during Fire).
